verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's CLI supports creating releases (glitchtip-cli releases new) and claims Sentry API compatibility, which in Sentry's ecosystem includes release tracking, but there is no evidence in the pack of associating commits with releases, suspect-commit detection, or issues displaying 'first seen in release' info. missing for 10: commit/VCS integration for release association, suspect commit detection, issue UI showing first-seen release, any documentation or community confirmation of this specific workflow.
